summary_en: FY3/26 final dividend raised to ¥50/share from ¥44 forecast issued 7 November 2025; +6 yen revision; +8 yen vs. prior year result (¥42).
title_en: Notice of revised dividend forecast (dividend hike) for FY3/26
translation_en_brief: On 7 August 2026, Colan Totte Co., Ltd. announced a revision to its FY3/26 final dividend forecast. The board resolved to raise the final dividend to ¥50 per share, an increase of ¥6 from the ¥44 per share announced on 7 November 2025. This represents an ¥8 increase compared to the prior year result of ¥42 per share. The company states its dividend policy prioritizes continuous improvement of corporate value and stable, sustained shareholder returns while maintaining balance between dividends and internal reserves, taking into account business performance, financial condition, and capital investment needs.
